:::{#hero-heading}

::: {.hero-intro}
[Christoph Scheuch]{.hero-name}

[Financial economist · Reproducible research · Data workflows]{.hero-tagline}
:::

I'm an Associate Researcher at [Humboldt University of Berlin](https://www.wiwi.hu-berlin.de/en/Professorships/bwl/finance), an Open Science Ambassador of the [Berlin University Alliance](https://www.berlin-university-alliance.de/en/commitments/research-quality/openx/os-botschafter-innen/index.html), and a Data Editor at the [Review of Financial Studies](https://review-of-financial-studies.github.io/). 

I co-created the open-source projects [Tidy Finance](https://www.tidy-finance.org/) and [EconDataverse](https://www.econdataverse.org/) to foster reproducible research in finance and economics. 

Through [Tidy Intelligence](https://www.tidy-intelligence.com/), I audit and improve data workflows. I also offer trainings in the practices that keep results trustworthy.
